lines.text: Flour rises in a beam of light as @maya_front pulls a golden loaf from the oven and taps its base.
Close on the tap; hear the hollow sound.

new_beats.text: You can always hear when it's ready.

writes.note: I added a short VO line that sets up the hollow tap and leaves the sound to speak.

reply.rationale: The VO is one short line placed ahead of the tap, so it frames the hollow sound without covering it. The shot's words are unchanged.
